items.statement: Compared with usual care, the protocol will reduce the proportion of patients with capillary glucose above 12 or below 4 mmol/L on the day of surgery from about 34 to 20 percent.
items.rationale: The retrieved before-after study suggests a reduction of this size; the local audit gives a similar baseline.
items.risks: Recruitment and outcome completeness at one hospital.

items.statement: The protocol can be delivered to at least 80 percent of patients, and outcome data can be complete for at least 90 percent, across general, orthopaedic and urological surgery.
items.rationale: The pilot trial failed on completeness; deliverability is the first uncertainty.

summary: Two hypotheses: effect (h1, selected) and deliverability (h2).
